_comment: 200 item pickups and182 harvest nodes. Original160 placements use the recorded grid;22 density_wave3 additions store current analytic route approaches separately. Historic hashes do not certify these additions. Candidate positions use production water_heightfield,6m grid flood-filled from safe landings with quarter-edge dry/slope checks. This is analytic placement evidence, not a body traversal or rendered density pass. Runtime must retain claim policies, exclusion zones and stable IDs. Authored paths currently need grading; these positions exclude disconnected gentle summits.
